claims.excerpt: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af: in de ene periode werden aanvragen aangenomen, in de andere was tijd gereserveerd voor testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.claim: During private beta, two-week sprints alternated so that applications were accepted in one period and time for testing, research, and processing was reserved for the other.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect
claims.evidence: We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af tussen aanvragen aannemen en tijd besteden aan testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.explanation: The source says the first week included testing and research as well as accepting applications; the second week suspended submissions and focused on testing, research, and processing. The content's alternating formulation implies that testing and research were reserved for the other period, omitting their presence in the application-acceptance week.
claims.materiality: Material to an account focused on the team's work rhythm; it changes what happened in each sprint period.

claims.excerpt: Zo beschreef de aanpak een volgorde waarin aanvragers eerst kwamen, naast vaste tijd voor onderzoek en testen.
claims.claim: The described approach combined an applicant-first sequence with dedicated time for research and testing.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence:
My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment. Plans for the caseworker user came later.

We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: De beschreven aanpak combineerde een volgorde waarin aanvragers eerst kwamen met expliciet gereserveerde tijd voor onderzoek en testen.
claims.explanation: The source supports both the applicant-first sequence and dedicated time for testing and research; the sentence presents them as features of the approach without claiming they caused the launch or results.
claims.materiality: Accurately summarizes the approach, though the preceding sprint description overstates the separation between activities.
